description_en: Queries the host accounts that are associated with a shared key
description_zh: 获取主机共享密钥关联的主机账号
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-host-accounts-for-host-share-key --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListHostAccountsForHostShareKey

parameters.help_en:
The bastion host ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the bastion host ID
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
Region ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The shared key ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/462973.html operation to query the shared key ID
parameters.help_zh:
主机共享密钥的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/462973.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: host_share_key_id

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 设置分页查询时，每页显示的主机共享密钥关联的主机账号的数量。默认值为10，表示每页显示10条主机共享密钥关联的主机账号
parameters.name: page_size

HostAccounts.description_en: An array that consists of the host accounts that are associated with the shared key
HostAccounts.description_zh: 主机共享密钥关联的主机账号的列表

HostAccountName.description_en: The name of the host account

HostsAccountId.description_en: The ID of the host account

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of the host accounts that are associated with the shared key
TotalCount.description_zh: 主机共享密钥关联的主机账号的总数量
